description: WF-3c is now the sole owner of the missed transition for all three domains. Handles both reminded-and-silent and never-dispatched, and escalates every one to WF-6.
name: ElderWise WF-3c - Missed Sweep (All Domains)

parameters.query: WITH esc AS (SELECT c.id, c.status, c.scheduled_for, c.reminder_sent_at, COALESCE(MIN(m.escalation_minutes), MIN(f.escalation_minutes), MIN(h.escalation_minutes), 30) AS esc_mins FROM checkins c JOIN elders e ON e.id = c.elder_id LEFT JOIN medications m ON c.domain = 'medication' AND m.elder_id = e.id AND m.enabled AND m.active AND to_char(c.scheduled_for AT TIME ZONE e.timezone, 'HH24:MI') = ANY(m.times) LEFT JOIN food_routines f ON f.id = c.food_routine_id LEFT JOIN health_routines h ON h.id = c.health_routine_id WHERE c.status IN ('reminded','scheduled') AND e.active AND e.consent_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.status, c.scheduled_for, c.reminder_sent_at), due AS (SELECT id FROM esc WHERE (status = 'reminded' AND reminder_sent_at IS NOT NULL AND now() > reminder_sent_at + make_interval(mins => esc_mins)) OR (status = 'scheduled' AND now() > scheduled_for + make_interval(mins => esc_mins))), upd AS (UPDATE checkins c SET status = 'missed', missed_at = now(), escalated_at = now() FROM due WHERE c.id = due.id RETURNING c.id) SELECT id AS checkin_id, 'missed' AS notification_type FROM upd

WITH orphaned AS (
  SELECT c.id
  FROM checkins c
  JOIN elders e ON e.id = c.elder_id
  WHERE c.status IN ('scheduled','sent','reminded')
    AND (
      (c.domain = 'medication' AND NOT EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM medications m
         WHERE m.elder_id = c.elder_id AND m.enabled AND m.active
           AND to_char(c.scheduled_for AT TIME ZONE e.timezone,'HH24:MI') = ANY(m.times)))
   OR (c.domain = 'food' AND NOT EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM food_routines f WHERE f.id = c.food_routine_id AND f.enabled))
   OR (c.domain = 'health' AND NOT EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM health_routines h WHERE h.id = c.health_routine_id AND h.enabled))
    )
), upd AS (
  UPDATE checkins c
  SET status = 'cancelled'::checkin_status, cancelled_at = now()
  FROM orphaned o
  WHERE c.id = o.id AND c.status IN ('scheduled','sent','reminded')
  RETURNING c.id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM upd) AS cancelled_count
